lines.text: - The vendored `stb_ds.h` no longer advances the global `stbds_hash_seed` when it creates a hash map; it only reads it, and the hunk is marked `VitaDeck:`.

lines.text: - `event_queue_push` now logs a warning when it drops an event on a full queue, and `CMakeLists.txt` links raylib into `event_queue_harness` for that `TraceLog` call.
